readingScope: All actual pages read; actual/printed mapping inspected individually. Eight selected visual pages checked.

corrections.issue: Electronegativity threshold and O–F nonpolar classification
corrections.decision: Treat cutoff as heuristic; distinguish bond polarity from molecular dipole.

corrections.issue: Pi bonds said not to determine shape; hybrid directions and expanded-octet d-orbital mechanism oversimplified
corrections.decision: Teach restricted rotation and model scope; include traditional geometry labels without asserting large d-orbital causation.
Distinguish domains, lone pairs, 2–6-domain arrangements and vector cancellation; eight-coordinate chart alternatives are not claimed as fully developed coordination chemistry.

corrections.issue: Interaction categories incomplete; phase unqualified; ether called nonpolar; dissolution and DNA association reduced to one force
corrections.decision: Separate dispersion/dipole/H-bond/ion-dipole interactions, state phase conditions and free-energy context; qualify stacking and solvent effects.

corrections.issue: Free rotation, trans stability and CIP/naming rules overgeneralised
corrections.decision: Explain barriers and eligibility; priorities local to each alkene carbon; numbering/alphabetisation do not determine CIP geometry.

corrections.issue: D/L conflated with rotation; 2^n exact rather than maximum; meso/racemate and biological examples need scope
corrections.decision: Separate R/S, D/L and measured sign. Correct contradiction between lactic figure and prose; teach symmetry and chiral discrimination without universal toxicity/microbial claims.

limitations: Original vector figures and answer keys author-checked; not a claim of official examination status
Selected source figures checked; not all external images/references certified
IUPAC D01512 web fetch was forbidden; independent stereochemical checks use accessible OpenStax pages and the internal source contradiction
Detailed transition-metal coordination and systematic nomenclature beyond this introductory unit remain outside claimed coverage
